title: Add /themes/new-world on the Nocturne page layout, real renders on all four surfaces

source.ref: LIVE-2059 (the page half): New World lane request 2026-11-03; the picker half stays on LIVE-2059

detail:
The page follows Nocturne's sections in order with the Website, Spotlight, Space and Email switcher in the hero preview. Thirty-four real renders under public/brand/new-world-kit: seven kits x four surfaces plus six Spotlight layouts, made by scripts/render/new-world-theme-shots.render.tsx and new-world-space-shots.render.tsx (Website through the real site chrome and blocks, Spotlight through the real layout, Space inside the real member shell, Email through the real email module). The page carries noindex and is not in the sitemap until the theme is un-hidden; whoever removes New World from RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS (LIVE-2059) also removes the noindex and adds the sitemap line. /themes/[theme] skips new-world.

 Shipped 2026-11-03.
